name: Coordinator agent (M1) — 8-case golden set
description: Phase 4 skeleton golden set per coordinator.spec.md §7 + Phase-4 brief. Covers the 16-Tier-1 routing fleet + remote A2A (tiktok-mcp-search), the four escalation paths (no_candidate_fits, ambiguous_task, low_confidence, policy_blocked), and the D34 4-locale rationale rendering. The full 200-task envelope golden set lands in tests/golden/coordinator/*.json during Phase 4 calibration.

metadata.brief: Phase 4 agent #1 (Tier-2 M1) brief — task router

metadata.note: Happy path — task obviously matches sourcing, both candidates valid, prefer_local=true breaks tie toward local.

parts.text: {"taskDescription":"Find 20 Korean skincare creators on TikTok with over 50k followers and engagement > 3%.","workspacePolicy":{"allowedAgents":[],"budgetRemainingUsd":2.50,"slaTargetMs":4000},"candidateAgents":[{"agentId":"sourcing","capabilities":["source_creators","tiktok","rapidapi"],"avgLatencyMs":2400,"avgCostUsd":0.018,"transport":"in_process","healthy":true},{"agentId":"tiktok-mcp-search","capabilities":["source_creators","tiktok","remote","a2a"],"avgLatencyMs":3100,"avgCostUsd":0.012,"transport":"a2a_grpc","healthy":true}],"locale":"en","allowRemote":true,"preferLocal":true}

{"chosenAgentId":"sourcing","routingRationale":"Local sourcing agent matches the TikTok creator-search capability and stays comfortably within the 4s SLA; preferLocal=true breaks the tie.","fallbackAgentId":"tiktok-mcp-search","expectedCostUsd":0.018,"expectedLatencyMs":2400,"confidence":0.92}

metadata.note: Operator explicitly asks for cost-priority + preferLocal=false → remote candidate wins on cost despite slightly higher latency.

parts.text: {"taskDescription":"Use the cheapest TikTok search agent available — cost is the priority, latency within SLA is fine.","workspacePolicy":{"allowedAgents":[],"budgetRemainingUsd":2.50,"slaTargetMs":4000},"candidateAgents":[{"agentId":"sourcing","capabilities":["source_creators","tiktok","rapidapi"],"avgLatencyMs":2400,"avgCostUsd":0.018,"transport":"in_process","healthy":true},{"agentId":"tiktok-mcp-search","capabilities":["source_creators","tiktok","remote","a2a"],"avgLatencyMs":3100,"avgCostUsd":0.012,"transport":"a2a_grpc","healthy":true}],"locale":"en","allowRemote":true,"preferLocal":false}

{"chosenAgentId":"tiktok-mcp-search","routingRationale":"Remote A2A agent is 33% cheaper ($0.012 vs $0.018) and the operator explicitly requested cost-priority with preferLocal=false.","fallbackAgentId":"sourcing","expectedCostUsd":0.012,"expectedLatencyMs":3100,"confidence":0.88}

metadata.note: Budget too tight — every candidate over_budget. Agent escalates per brief: 'no candidate satisfies policy'.

metadata.note: Korean rationale required — D34. Single candidate matches → no fallback.

metadata.note: Japanese rationale (D34). outreach_writer is the unique match for tournament-style drafting; budget is generous.
